title: NFL announces 2026 training camp, joint practice dates for every team
content:
The NFL announced on Monday training camp and joint practice dates and locations for all 32 teams.

The Seattle Seahawks’ rookies have the earliest report date on Friday, July 17. The rest of the rookies and veterans across the league report to their respective camps over the final two weeks of July.

New Arizona Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur will visit his older brother and Green Bay Packers head coach Matt LaFleur when their teams participate in a joint practice on Aug. 26.

The New Orleans Saints and Tennessee Titans have the busiest joint practice schedules with three each, while the Denver Broncos, Detroit Lions, Kansas City Chiefs and Pittsburgh Steelers don’t have joint practices on their schedules.

Here’s a breakdown of each team’s training camp and joint practice schedule.
